label: Pricing Card
description: A pricing tier card at video scale: tier name with a badge, a price that counts up, a feature list with check marks that builds in row by row, and a CTA button (filled when highlighted, outline otherwise). Place two or three side by side for a plan comparison.

description.label: One line under the tier name

badge.label: Badge text (default 'Most popular' when highlighted; '' for none)

compare_price.label: Struck-through old price before the price (e.g. $79)

theme.label: Card theme; omit to follow the scene ground (a dark ground gets a dark card)

at.label: Seconds into the scene the card enters (default 0.2)

exit.label: Fade out before the scene ends (default: hold; the cut is the exit)
